services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Give your group something to talk about with a Once Upon A Nation storytelling experience. With several tour and theme options, your group will engage in lively exchanges and interactive experiences as they come face-to-face with our nation’s History Makers. From young school groups to programs for seniors, Once Upon A Nation offers group activities and tours for all ages that are informative, educational, and best of all, fun! Once Upon A Nation walking tours are best experienced by groups that max out at 30 people. Along the routes, your guests will encounter our thoroughly trained, researched and costumed History Makers at the locations where history was made. Your personal History Maker

services.name: Philly Mini Golf
services.desc: Center City’s favorite year-round miniature golf course is designed after favorite Philly landmarks like the Liberty Bell, the LOVE Statue, the Chinatown Friendship Arch, Elfreth’s Alley, the Ben Franklin Bridge, AND MORE. Celebrate National Mini Golf Day on Monday, September 21, with buy-one-get-one-free mini golf! services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Make some history of your own and host your event in Philadelphia’s historic district. Options abound. Host an outdoor birthday picnic, a baby shower in a climate-controlled space, or a wedding for hundreds in an exquisitely appointed tented pavilion. Whichever you choose, the Historic Philadelphia, Inc. experienced event staff will smooth out all the details so you can actually be a guest at your own event. For an event that will go down in the books, check out these event spaces.
